headline.caveat: enterprise value; consortium of AIP, MGX, and BlackRock's GIP acquired 100% of the equity from Macquarie Asset Management, plus a further $5B committed growth capital

realized_to_date.caveat: closed Jul 2026; equity/debt split of the consideration not disclosed

nature_md: The AI Infrastructure Partnership (AIP — founding members BlackRock/GIP, Microsoft, MGX, NVIDIA, xAI; anchor investors incl. KIA and Temasek), together with MGX and BlackRock's GIP directly, closed the ~$40B acquisition of 100% of Aligned Data Centers from Macquarie Asset Management in July 2026 — the largest private digital-infrastructure deal to date and AIP's marquee deployment from its $30B equity mandate (up to $100B with debt). Aligned brings 51 campuses and >6.4GW operational/planned. The buyers committed an additional $5B of growth capital for AI-ready capacity. This edge records AIP as the named acquirer of record for the consortium; MGX and GIP co-invested directly.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Consortium equity (AIP vehicle + MGX + GIP funds) plus assumed/raised acquisition debt at the Aligned level; for AIP's members this is fund capital, not corporate balance-sheet M&A. Microsoft and NVIDIA participate economically as AIP members while also being, respectively, a major tenant category and the supplier of what fills the buildings.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Sale proceeds to Macquarie Asset Management funds (exit); Aligned itself continues under new ownership with $5B of committed growth capital. Purchase price implies a full-cycle bet that AI-driven data-center demand persists at ~$6.25M+/MW valuations.

events.title: AIP/MGX/GIP close ~$40B acquisition of Aligned Data Centers
